paragraphs: The official rate for a dollar in Turkey rose 14.0062% between 10 Aug and 13 Aug 2018. The street price had not moved 3% in the 9 days before.
Turkey's central bank said on 13 Aug 2018 it would give banks all the money they need [1]. It also lowered the amount banks must keep with it [1].

sources.title: Turkey's central bank moves to support banks, vows to provide liquidity
